Citizenship in The Community Means Principle 4: Unless they are upset about a particularissue, most citizens leave the decisions to elected representatives and local activists (p. 10).

Step 2 (Citizenship in The Community Means): The more active citizens are in their community, withties to a school, youth groups, businesses, and service clubs, the more interest they (p. 10).
Step 3 (Citizenship in The Community Means): Thatis why longtime residents often hold local offices (p. 10).
Step 4 (Citizenship in The Community Means): You have a chance now to build connections in your own community (p. 10).
